title: Two child support contracts lacked documented federal vendor checks

beats.text: A City contract could meet local purchasing rules and still need a separate federal check.
Auditors tested seven of twenty-eight child support contracts.

visual.kicker: Two contract files lacked the eligibility check

beats.text: Two files lacked evidence of the check before the contracts were signed.

visual.kicker: Two contract files lacked the eligibility check

beats.text: The federal spending under those contracts was $80,774.

visual.label: The auditors independently checked both contractors

beats.text: The auditors checked the federal exclusion list themselves.

visual.kicker: The auditors independently checked both contractors

beats.text: Neither contractor was excluded, and the auditors questioned no costs.
The department agreed to keep the eligibility check in the file.

visual.kicker: The department changed its verification procedure

beats.text: The FY2015 audit marked that corrective action implemented.

visual.kicker: The department changed its verification procedure

beats.text: We checked all 803 department voucher rows for the year.
Those records cannot identify the two suppliers with confidence.
